abstract: Ovarian masses in children are uncommon. We reviewed all cases of ovarian masses presenting to this hospital from 1979 to 1990. Ninety-one patients fulfilled the criteria and had medical records available. All patients were less than 18 years old. Four were diagnosed antenatally. Thirty-four tumors presented prior to 8 years of age and 1 (2.9%) was malignant. Fifty-eight tumors presented after 8 years of age and 18 (33%) were malignant. Seventy-two patients had benign disease and 19 had malignant tumors. Of those with benign disease 22 had simple or epithelial cysts, 25 had teratomas, 13 had torsion with cyst formation, 3 had granulosa cell tumors, and 9 had other less common lesions. Analysis of symptoms could not distinguish between benign and malignant lesions; however, age was less (P < .03) and tumor size smaller (P < .001) in patients with benign lesions. Benign lesions presented at a mean age of 8.8 years. Fifty-four patients had an ultrasound, all were diagnostic: simple mass (14), complex mass (8), or cyst (32). Mean size of the masses was 9.5 x 7.7 cm. Fourteen patients had a contralateral ovarian cyst. The malignant lesions included 14 germ cell tumors (4 endodermal sinus, 4 teratoma, 2 choriocarcinoma, 2 dysgerminoma, 1 embryonal, and 1 mixed), 4 epithelial tumors (1 mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, papillary cystadenocarcinoma, papillary serous cystadenocarcinoma, and endometrioid adenocarcinoma), and one patient with leukemic infiltration (ALL). Germ cell tumors presented at a mean age of 11.8 years. Eight of these patients had an ultrasound and all showed a mass (7) or cyst (1).(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 小児の卵巣腫瘤は稀である。1979年から1990年に当院を受診した卵巣腫瘤症例を後方視的に検討した。基準を満たし診療録が入手可能な患者91例が該当した。全例18歳未満であった。4例は出生前に診断された。34例は8歳未満で発症し、そのうち悪性は1例(2.9%)であった。58例は8歳以降に発症し、そのうち18例(33%)が悪性であった。良性疾患は72例、悪性腫瘍は19例であった。良性疾患のうち、単純性または上皮性嚢胞が22例、奇形腫が25例、捻転に伴う嚢胞形成が13例、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍が3例、その他稀な病変が9例であった。症状の分析では良性と悪性を区別できなかった。ただし、良性病変の患者では年齢が低く、腫瘤サイズも小さかった(P<.03、P<.001)。良性病変の平均発症年齢は8.8歳であった。54例に超音波検査が施行され、全例で診断が得られた：単純性腫瘤14例、複雑性腫瘤8例、嚢胞32例。腫瘤の平均サイズは9.5×7.7cmであった。14例では対側にも卵巣嚢胞がみられた。悪性病変は14例の胚細胞腫瘍(卵黄嚢腫瘍4例、奇形腫4例、絨毛癌2例、ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)2例、胎児性癌1例、混合型1例)、4例の上皮性腫瘍(粘液性嚢胞腺癌1例、乳頭状嚢胞腺癌、乳頭状漿液性嚢胞腺癌、類内膜腺癌)、白血病浸潤(ALL)1例を含んでいた。胚細胞腫瘍の平均発症年齢は11.8歳であった。これらの患者8例に超音波検査が行われ、全例で腫瘤(7例)または嚢胞(1例)が認められた。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
